title: Efficient Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
abstract: arXiv:2611.22444v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) reach an accuracy close to quantum mechanical reference calculations at a small fraction of the cost. Efficiency is the purpose of MLIPs, yet strategies for efficient MLIPs have not been reviewed systematically. This review takes efficiency as its guideline. To compare MLIPs on a common footing, we represent them in a complete basis expansion, the Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) and its graph generalization (GRACE). The expansion is canonical, built from products of single-particle functions. Classical interatomic potentials, such as the embedded-atom method, and many modern MLIPs, including equivariant transformers, can be represented within this expansion. Much of the apparent diversity of MLIP architectures therefore reflects how non-linearity, layer coupling and optimization are handled rather than which interactions the models can represent. translated_title: 高效机器学习原子间势
translated_abstract: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）能够以量子力学参考计算成本的一小部分达到接近其精度的水平。效率是MLIPs的目的所在，然而关于高效MLIPs的策略尚未被系统地综述。本综述以效率为指导原则。为了在统一的基础上比较各种MLIPs，我们将其表示在完备基组展开中，即原子簇展开（ACE）及其图推广形式（GRACE）。该展开是正则的，由单粒子函数的乘积构建而成。经典原子间势（如嵌入原子方法）以及许多现代MLIPs（包括等变变换器）都可以在这个展开框架中表示。因此，MLIP架构的大部分表面多样性反映的是如何处理非线性、层耦合和优化问题，而非模型能够表示哪些相互作用。我们展示了MLIP的计算成本如何变为线性……
tldr: 该综述以原子簇展开（ACE/GRACE）这一统一数学框架为基础，系统性地梳理了高效机器学习原子间势的设计策略，并揭示各类MLIP架构的表面多样性主要源于非线性处理、层耦合与优化方式的不同，而非模型可表示的相互作用范围。
en_tdlr: This review systematically examines efficient machine learning interatomic potentials using the Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) and its graph generalization (GRACE) as a unifying framework, showing that the apparent diversity of MLIP architectures reflects how non-linearity, layer coupling, and optimization are handled rather than which interactions the models can represent.
